workedExamples.prompt: Compare “badge” and “catch”. What does each ending represent?
workedExamples.solution: The -dge ending represents /j/ in badge; -tch represents /ch/ in catch.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner swaps the endings in spelling. What should be checked?
